arxiv-2011-14057.title: Multidimensional Persistence Module Classification via Lattice-Theoretic Convolutions
arxiv-2011-14057.creator: Hans Riess, Jakob Hansen, Robert Ghrist
arxiv-2011-14057.description: Abstract Multiparameter persistent homology has been largely neglected as an input to machine learning algorithms. We consider the use of lattice-based convolutional neural network layers as a tool for the analysis of features arising from multiparameter persistence modules. We find that these show promise as an alternative to convolutions for the classification of multidimensional persistence modules.

arxiv-2102-12443.title: A Straightforward Framework For Video Retrieval Using CLIP
arxiv-2102-12443.creator: Jesús Andrés Portillo-Quintero, José Carlos Ortiz-Bayliss, Hugo Terashima-Marín
arxiv-2102-12443.description: Abstract Video Retrieval is a challenging task where a text query is matched to a video or vice versa. Most of the existing approaches for addressing such a problem rely on annotations made by the users. Although simple, this approach is not always feasible in practice.

arxiv-2110-00799.title: Curved space and particle physics effects on the formation of Bose-Einstein condensation around a Reissner - Nordtstrøm black hole
arxiv-2110-00799.creator: Recai Erdem, Betül Demirkaya, Kemal Gültekin
arxiv-2110-00799.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Recai Erdem, Betül Demirkaya, Kemal Gültekin. We consider two scalar fields interacting through a χ ∗ ​ χ ​ ϕ ∗ ​ ϕ \chi^{*}\chi\phi^{*}\phi term in the presence of a Reissner - Nordstrøm black hole. Initially, only χ \chi particles are present. We find that the produced ϕ \phi particles are localized in a region around the black hole and have a tendency towards condensation provided that ϕ \phi particles are much heavier than the χ \chi particles.

arxiv-2110-05877.title: OpenHands : Making Sign Language Recognition Accessible with Pose-based Pretrained Models across Languages
arxiv-2110-05877.creator: Prem Selvaraj, Gokul NC, Pratyush Kumar, Mitesh Khapra
arxiv-2110-05877.description: Abstract AI technologies for Natural Languages have made tremendous progress recently. However, commensurate progress has not been made on Sign Languages, in particular, in recognizing signs as individual words or as complete sentences. We introduce OpenHands 1 1 1 https://github.

arxiv-2201-04295.title: Strongly interacting impurities in a dilute Bose condensate
arxiv-2201-04295.creator: Nikolay Yegovtsev, Pietro Massignan, Victor Gurarie

For a dilute Bose gas its properties are expected to be universal, that is dependent only on a few parameters characterizing the boson-impurity interactions. When boson-impurity interactions are weak, it has been known for some time that the properties of the polaron depend only on the scattering length of these interactions. arxiv-2207-07072.creator: Guy Blanc, Caleb Koch, Jane Lange, Li-Yang Tan
arxiv-2207-07072.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guy Blanc, Caleb Koch, Jane Lange, Li-Yang Tan. We design an algorithm for finding counterfactuals with strong theoretical guarantees on its performance. arxiv-2305-19692.title: Inferring redshift and energy distributions of fast radio bursts from the first CHIME/FRB catalog Thanks: Supported by the National Natural Science Fund of China under grant Nos. 11873001, 12147102 and 12275034.
arxiv-2305-19692.creator: Li Tang 1 Hai-Nan Lin 2,3;1) Xin Li 2,3
arxiv-2305-19692.description: Abstract We reconstruct the extragalactic dispersion measure – redshift relation ( DM E − z {\rm DM_{E}}-z relation) from well-localized fast radio bursts (FRBs) using Bayesian inference method. Then the DM E − z {\rm DM_{E}}-z relation is used to infer the redshift and energy of the first CHIME/FRB catalog.

arxiv-2312-12110.title: An Isoperimetric Inequality and Pursuit-Evasion Games on Triangular Grid Graphs
arxiv-2312-12110.creator: Athipatana Iamphongsai, Teeradej Kittipassorn
arxiv-2312-12110.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove an isoperimetric inequality for the triangular grid graph which was conjectured by Adams, Gibson, and Pfaffinger, using the compression technique of Bollobás and Leader. Moreover, we apply the isoperimetric inequality to the Zero-Visibility Search game and Lions and Contamination game in order to obtain lower bounds for the inspection number and lion number respectively.

arxiv-2403-11110.title: Smart structural health monitoring (SHM) system for on-board localization of defects in pipes using torsional ultrasonic guided waves
arxiv-2403-11110.creator: Sheetal Patil, Sauvik Banerjee, Siddharth Tallur
arxiv-2403-11110.description: Abstract Most reported research for monitoring health of pipelines using ultrasonic guided waves (GW) typically utilize bulky piezoelectric transducer rings and laboratory-grade ultrasonic non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. Consequently, the translation of these approaches from laboratory settings to field-deployable systems for real-time structural health monitoring (SHM) becomes challenging.

arxiv-2404-17986.title: On a Stochastic Differential Equation with Correction Term Governed by a Monotone and Lipschitz Continuous Operator
arxiv-2404-17986.creator: Radu Ioan Bo t ,, Chiara Schindler
arxiv-2404-17986.description: Abstract In our pursuit of finding a zero for a monotone and Lipschitz continuous operator M : ℝ n → ℝ n M:\mathbb{R}^{n}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n} amidst noisy evaluations, we explore an associated differential equation within a stochastic framework, incorporating a correction term. We present a result establishing the existence and uniqueness of solutions for the stochastic differential equations under examination.

arxiv-2410-01018.title: Risk-Averse Planning and Plan Assessment for Marine Robots *
arxiv-2410-01018.creator: Mahya Mohammadi Kashani, Tobias John, Jeremy P. Coffelt, Einar Broch Johnsen, Andrzej Wąsowski
arxiv-2410-01018.description: Abstract Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) need to operate for days without human intervention and thus must be able to do efficient and reliable task planning. Unfortunately, efficient task planning requires deliberately abstract domain models (for scalability reasons), which in practice leads to plans that might be unreliable or under performing in practice.

arxiv-2502-05384.title: Demonstrating CavePI: Autonomous Exploration of Underwater Caves by Semantic Guidance Thanks: ⋆ These two authors have contributed equally. Thanks: Accepted for publication at the Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS), 2025, Los Angeles, CA, US.
arxiv-2502-05384.creator: Alankrit Gupta, Adnan Abdullah, Xianyao Li, Vaishnav Ramesh, Ioannis Rekleitis, Md Jahidul Islam
arxiv-2502-05384.description: Abstract Enabling autonomous robots to safely and efficiently navigate, explore, and map underwater caves is of significant importance to water resource management, hydrogeology, archaeology, and marine robotics. In this work, we demonstrate the system design and algorithmic integration of a visual servoing framework for semantically guided autonomous underwater cave exploration.

arxiv-2503-10053.title: Distinguishing Tidal Disruption Events and Changing-look Active Galactic Nuclei via Variation of Mid-infrared Color
arxiv-2503-10053.creator: Yujun Yao, Jingjing Ye, Luming Sun, Ning Jiang, Megan Masterson, Xinwen Shu
arxiv-2503-10053.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yujun Yao, Jingjing Ye, Luming Sun, Ning Jiang, Megan Masterson, Xinwen Shu. In this work, we propose that the time variation of mid-infrared (MIR) color is a promising probe to distinguish between MIR outbursts induced by tidal disruption events (TDEs) and changing-look active galactic nuclei (CLAGNs). With an optically selected sample containing TDEs, ambiguous nuclear transients (ANTs), and CLAGNs, we studied the variation of MIR color ( W ​ 1 − W ​ 2 W1-W2 ) after subtracting the quiescent fluxes using NEOWISE-R data.

arxiv-2509-20409.title: A Unified Formal Theory on the Logical Limits of Symbol Grounding
arxiv-2509-20409.creator: Zhangchi Liu
arxiv-2509-20409.description: Abstract This paper synthesizes a series of formal proofs to construct a unified theory on the logical limits of the Symbol Grounding Problem. We demonstrate through a four-stage argument that meaning within a formal system must arise from a process that is external, dynamic, and non-algorithmic.

arxiv-2512-01800.title: Conservative Formulations of the Standard Enskog and Povzner Equations
arxiv-2512-01800.creator: Zhe Chen
arxiv-2512-01800.description: Abstract . This article introduces a conservative formulation of the Standard Enskog equation and the Povzner equation, both of which generalize the Boltzmann equation by incorporating the contribution of particle volume in collisions. The primary result expresses these collision integrals as the divergence with respect to the velocity variable v v of a mass current.

pmc-10610053.title: Effects of Five Coumarins and Standardized Extracts from Tagetes lucida Cav. on Motor Impairment and Neuroinflammation Induced with Cuprizone
pmc-10610053.creator: Gabriela Castro-Martínez, Maribel Herrera-Ruiz, Manases González-Cortázar, Sandra Liliana Porras-Dávila, Julio Cesar Almanza Pérez, Enrique Jimenez-Ferrer
pmc-10610053.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease of the central nervous system (CNS) with no curative treatment, and the available therapies aim to modify the course of the disease. It has been demonstrated that extracts of Tagetes lucida have immunomodulatory and neuroprotective effects.

pmc-11476685.title: An exploratory study of the impact of CT slice thickness and inter-rater variability on anatomical accuracy of malunited distal radius models and surgical guides for corrective osteotomy
pmc-11476685.creator: Emilia Gryska, Per Fredrikson, Katleen Libberecht, Charlotte Stor Swinkels, Peter Axelsson, Anders Björkman, Xiaohui Zhang, Xiaohui Zhang, Xiaohui Zhang
pmc-11476685.description: High-resolution CT images are essential in clinical practice to accurately replicate patient anatomy for 3D virtual surgical planning and designing patient-specific surgical guides. These technologies are commonly used in corrective osteotomy of the distal radius. This study evaluated how the virtual radius models and the surgical guides’ surface that is in contact with the bone vary between experienced raters.

pmc-11666710.title: Ireland’s Mental Health Bill 2024: progress, problems and Procrustean perils
pmc-11666710.creator: Brendan D. Kelly
pmc-11666710.description: BackgroundIreland’s Mental Health Bill 2024 proposes the most significant revision of mental health legislation since the Mental Health Act 2001.AimsTo explore the 2024 Bill and provide suggestions for the subsequent Act.MethodsReview of the 2024 Bill and related literature.ResultsThe 2024 Bill proposes useful new definitions (e.g., ‘mental disorder’, ‘treatment’) and provisions governing specific practices (e.g., ‘physical restraint’).

pmc-12463499.title: Health literacy for patient education and counseling in the genomic era: challenges and perspectives

pmc-12463499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). of complete genetic information, requires adequate literacy as the primary key to better understand genomic concepts, patient care, ethical implications, autonomy, and privacy issues, including social dimensions of genetic testing, to empower patients in making informed health decisions [1]. Genomic literacy requires healthcare professionals to communicate complex ideas and terminology, while patients who often lack a background in genetics rely on them to interpret the results from increasingly accessible commercial genetic tests.

pmc-12650626.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Cancer Prognostics: Integrating Temporal and Immune Gene Dynamics via ARIMA-CNN
pmc-12650626.creator: Rui-Bin Lin, Linlin Zhou, Yu-Chun Lin, Yu Yu, Hung-Chih Yang, Chen-Wei Yu
pmc-12650626.description: Background: Hepatocellular carcinoma remains a global health challenge with high mortality rates. The tumor immune microenvironment significantly impacts disease progression and survival. However, traditional analyses predominantly focus on single immune genes, overlooking the critical interplay among multiple immune gene signatures.

pmc-12709425.title: MreB filaments in the elongasome modulate E. coli membrane curvature
pmc-12709425.creator: Becca WA Baileeves, Anthony DQ Hoang, Timothy DH Bugg, Phillip J Stansfeld
pmc-12709425.description: MreB, a bacterial actin homolog, plays a pivotal role in defining the shape of rod-shaped bacteria by coordinating peptidoglycan synthesis during cell elongation. It forms filaments that interact with the cytosolic leaflet of the cell membrane, as well as with membrane proteins and other cytosolic proteins.

pmc-12860146.title: The dysbiosis of intestinal microbiota associated with isolated tricuspid valve regurgitation
pmc-12860146.creator: Tongkai Ge, Dou Fang, Lishan Zhong, Shanwen Pang, Lin bin Hua, Jimei Chen, Junfei Zhao, Huanlei Huang
pmc-12860146.description: BackgroundIsolated tricuspid regurgitation (TR) is an increasingly recognized yet frequently underappreciated valvular disorder that adversely affects both survival and quality of life, with progressively worse outcomes as severity increases. Advances in high-throughput sequencing technologies have considerably expanded our understanding of the human microbiome, uncovering its close associations with a range of cardiovascular diseases, including atherosclerosis, heart failure, and hypertension.

pmc-12955123.title: Management of a chronic non-healing viper bite ulcer in a patient with alcoholic liver cirrhosis: A Case Report
pmc-12955123.creator: Maitri J Parmar, Rutu D Shah, Kalapi B Patel, Shivenarain N Gupta, Manish V Patel
pmc-12955123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Snake bite complication often lead to tissue necrosis, cellulitis, non-healing ulcers and systemic disturbance such as coagulopathy and ascites, making management highly challenging. A 50-year-old male presented with chronic non-healing ulcer on the right limb that persisted for 58 days despite conventional treatment and was associated with severe pain, foul odour and deep tissue involvement including subcutaneous tissue and facia, bone and muscle were not exposed.

pmc-13245795.title: Sprint velocity and step frequency during repeated sprint ability testing are associated with high-intensity locomotor activity in elite female field hockey
pmc-13245795.creator: Carlos Rivera, Pablo González-Frutos, Fernando Naclerio, Javier Mallo, Santiago Veiga, Paul Goods, Paul Goods, Paul Goods, Paul Goods
pmc-13245795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Field hockey is an intermittent, high-intensity team sport in which global positioning system (GPS) monitoring and field-based fitness testing are widely used; however, the relationship between repeated sprint ability (RSA) determinants and match physical demands remains unclear. This study examined the association between RSA kinematic variables (sprint velocity, step frequency, and step length) and GPS-derived locomotor activity metrics during elite female field hockey matches.

pmc-13580744.title: Medical code embeddings from claims-based co-occurrences: a unified semantic space for ICD-10 diagnoses and ATC medications
pmc-13580744.creator: Corentin Faujour, Stéphane Bouée, Corinne Emery, Anne-Sophie Jannot
pmc-13580744.description: ObjectiveThe analysis of care trajectories derived from electronic health records and claims data has become increasingly common in biomedical informatics. This has enabled large-scale studies of care processes, yet widely used binary code representations result in high-dimensional, sparse data that fail to capture semantic relationships between medical concepts.
